name: Amber Bow
description: A bow with the color of sunny amber or dunes. Its shots can pierce anything.

name: Antler Bow
description: Designed in admiration of antlers, this bow has an imperial and awe-inspiring image.

name: Arsonist's Bow
description: A bow that sparks blazing joy in firebugs and aspiring pyromaniacs.

name: Avalanche Starter
description: When placed in competent hands, this horned bow can fire a shot so powerful that it may loosen an avalanche, and bury the valleys in everlasting snow.

name: Banebringer
description: An infested Shroud bow, able to teach the true meaning of pain.

name: Bow
description: An improvised bow made out of basic materials. Unfortunately, the bowstring is quite loose.

name: Bow Of The Serpent
description: A strong bow that frames each shot between two serpents' maws. Let your arrows strike with the calculated savagery of a viper in waiting!

name: Bow Of The Twin Moons
description: The decorative orbs attached to the bow's body light up and darken in sync. Always together, chained to an otherworldly rhythm, an ebb and flow from beyond.

name: Breaching Bow
description: A bow that breaches all — flesh, scales, borders. Nothing can withstand its might.

name: Brisk Bow
description: Every true shot makes the blood pump faster.

name: Composite Bow
description: This is a very sophisticated bow with high tension.

name: Devilish Bow
description: This draconic-looking bow was often feared for its crooked horns of unknown origin. Villagers believed that horns so twisted would always bring bad luck.

name: Draconian Bow
description: Crafted to resemble the wings of the most infamous Kindlewastes dwellers, the Draconian Vulture.

name: Dragon's Wing
description: Gain the strength of a dragon with this legendary weapon.

name: Drak Whistle Bow
description: This bow was fashioned after the likeness of the Drak'Dal, even though they don't use such weapons themselves. An arrow shot from this bow will split the air like the sharp whistle of the drakian tongue.

name: Fell Marksman Bow
description: Forged for ruthless efficiency, the Fell Marksman Bow finds its purpose in the skulls of Scavengers who dare cross its path.

name: Fell Scout Bow
description: Pierce Enemies in the back with arrows shot from this precise Fell Scout Bow, perfect for those who prefer their enemies dealt with from a comfortable distance.

name: Firefeather Bow
description: A formidable bow that ignites foes from afar. It bears crimson fangs that jut from its centre and carries diamond-shaped appendages along its body. It reminds you of a bloodsucking bat or a fiery bird with a fearsome beak.

name: Forest Longbow
description: This bow has great tension, making it exhausting to use. It does great damage in exchange.

name: Forsaken
description: Lost and forgotten amidst the Shroud, this bow unleashes fury on anyone that crosses its path.

name: Horned Beast Bow
description: A bow crafted to resemble the horned beasts of the Albaneve Summits. It makes for a fearsome silhouette.

name: Hunter's Bow
description: A finely handcrafted bow, used by seasoned woodland hunters.

name: Ignited Bow
description: Ignited by the Flame itself, this bow pulses with the power of fire.

name: Lunar Tides Bow
description: The upper and lower limbs of the bow curve inwards gracefully, creating the shape of symmetrical waves coming to a crash as the shot is fired. May the crescent illuminate your arrows and steady your breath.

name: Nightwind Bow
description: A bow that's fueled by the dark shimmer of the Shroud.

name: Ornate Wood Bow
description: A top-quality bow inspired by antlers. One might call it art.

name: Phoenix Bow
description: An asymmetrical bow that's headed by a golden phoenix. The drawstring is reinforced with yellow diamonds that reflect the light with every little movement.

name: Pine Shortbow
description: A practical and quick bow made from humble pine wood.

name: Rattlesnake Bow
description: The bow curves into a zig-zag shape on both sides, capturing a vision of a rattlesnake's tail in motion.

name: Shadowbane
description: An accurate bow imbued with the mysterious powers of the Shroud.

name: Silvershot Bow
description: A bow that aims to strike the heart of the dark with silver-tipped arrows and no hesitation.

name: Snowflake Splicer
description: This bow is so precise that it can split a faraway snowflake in two.

name: Spearfisher Bow
description: Whether used to shoot birds from the sky or fish in the water, this bow is precise and vicious. It's definitely more stylish than a fishing rod, though it's less effective for the same purpose... perhaps its venom would be better used on other wildlife instead.

name: Spiked Bow
description: The shots from this spiked bow can pierce anything.

name: Talion's Bow
description: A bow used by Commanders of the Northern Guard. A powerful energy flows through the user, increasing their pulse and allowing for faster shots.

name: Tarred Bow
description: This bow's natural resistance to fire makes it perfect for firing volleys of flaming arrows.

name: Temple Keeper's Bow
description: Instead of exploiting the ruins of forgotten times, you vow to protect them — to uphold their sanctity for reverence not only today, but tomorrow.

name: Tomb Raider's Bow
description:
A standard, carved bow that reminds you of forgotten temples and overgrown tombs. Makes you want to go exploring for hidden riches!

Grave robbing is bad, and you shouldn't do it while anyone is looking.

name: Traitor's Bow
description: This bow fires easily against creatures of the Shroud.

name: Wildwood Shortbow
description: This sturdy oak wood bow has a high rate of fire and conserves your energy at the expense of damage.

name: Winged Shadow
description: The arrow's shadow darts across the battlefield. Its presence is swift and fleeting, a daydream carried by a gust of wind — but its impact is precisely devastating. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Wolf's Snarl Longbow
description: This fine longbow is exhausting to use, but it strikes with the ferocity of a wolf.

name: Adorned Drakling Daggers
description: Only Draklings skilled enough earn the right to wield these adorned daggers. They often remain a trusted weapon for a lifetime. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Ascendant Daggers
description: A prideful set of daggers. They foretell a path through the galaxy, enabling the wielder to rise and slash their mark into a star-dotted sky. 3 golden rings mark the handle's beginning and end. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Astral Daggers
description: A quick set of daggers that reflects the light of the stars above. The handle is topped by an elliptical guard that appears to be floating. It reminds one of planetary rings. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Baroness Daggers
description: An elegant dual dagger set with extravagant gold detailing. It's slim enough to be smuggled underneath a nightgown unseen into any chamber. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Blink Daggers
description: Striking in the blink of an eye, these daggers can slash any throat quickly and quietly. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Blunt Knives
description: A dull set of daggers. Simple, but still efficient in a pinch. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Broodmother's Eye
description: These Daggers are adorned with crystal inlays shaped like eyes, a constant reminder to their wielders that the Broodmother Vesztah watches them at all times. It is believed that she guides their hand — ensuring that only the strongest may hatch, while the weak are struck down by the blade's edge. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Circus Knives
description: A pair of circus knives that can do a lot of damage if left in untrained hands! Better watch out! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Corrosive Daggers
description: These blades were corroded by being submerged in poison for too long. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Crystal Knives
description: A crystalline frame lines the edges of these short blades. They shift incoming light and reflect it, bathing the daggers in the color of fresh mountain springs. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Daggers
description: A rudimentary set of daggers, the secondary weapon of choice for archers. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Daggers Of Liquid Light
description: The blades thicken and slim periodically in subtle waves, as if they were forged from pure, liquid light. Be careful not to blind yourself when wielding these in battle! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Drakling Daggers
description: These daggers mark the next stage for young Drak after training with bamboo sticks. Their compact size makes them easy to wield even from an early age. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Falk Fall Daggers
description: The edge of these daggers is shaped like the beak of a soaring eagle, willing to strike down toward its enemies. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Grey Blades
description: A pair of dark, grey daggers adorned with a bright green gem the color of envy. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Half-Light Halos
description: Step only where you remain unseen, strike those whose eyes are blinded by your glint in the half-light. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Horn Daggers
description: The many layers of smelted metal in these daggers make them appear similar to an animal's tiered horn, tapering off at the edges. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Ice-Coated Daggers
description: The tip of these daggers has become permanently frosted after piercing the ice-cold heart of a Cyclops. Either that or someone tried their hand at spearfishing and left their blades in the freezing waters too long. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Lightforged Daggers
description: Daggers that were bathed in sunlight during forging. Their spiked edge can cause a lot of damage! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Makeshift Daggers
description: A long pair of daggers with cloth around the handle. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Nightfall
description: A dagger set made from darkened steel, reflecting the moonlight on its fractured edges. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Nightnebula
description: A mystical pair of blades used for unspeakable divinations held under the full moon. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Oath Breaker
description: There are only a few ways to flee a promise you don't intend to keep. At least one of them involves murder. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Parade Daggers
description: These spiky daggers were often worn by soldiers around their belts during parades as a show of force. Sometimes, children are gifted a simpler version as their first weapon. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Proud Daggers
description: Daggers with many edges and sharp hooks. They can be whipped out in the blink of an eye to parry incoming attacks, thus defending your honor. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Sacrificial Vukah Dagger
description: A crude dagger, previously used by a Vukah in a bloody ritual. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Sandstorm Swiftblades
description: A dagger set of old-timey Eastern craftsmanship. Rogues of that era would swing this short cutlass around during battle, causing nearby sand to swirl up and blind the enemy. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Scrap Daggers
description: A pair of rudimentary and jagged Scavenger daggers. These are commonly wielded by the weakest of the pack, also called Scabs. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Shellbreaker Daggers
description: Sometimes a Drak hatchling proves too weak to break its shell. In such cases, the Broodwardens use this poison-tipped blade to cut the egg open. The young bear a mark from that day onward — a symbol of frailty that brands them for life, forever beneath those who hatched unaided. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Shivering Skeans
description: A frosty set of daggers said to be infused with the souls of those who died in the coldest yearfalls. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Shivs
description: A dagger set that was scavenged from the ruins of the old world. It's dirty and dusty, but still does the trick. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Sleek Daggers
description: These daggers are sleek and swift. The blade is sharp as ever. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Solstice Daggers
description: They unveil their true power during the solstice, as if they were recharged and invigorated by the sun's rays. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: The Needles
description: A fine pair of twin daggers meant to pierce arteries with precision and grace. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Valor Heart Daggers
description: A dagger that can easily be hidden underneath lavish sleeves or dressy skirts. It's quick and easy to unsheath in times of need! Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Venomkiss
description: A deviously poisoned set of daggers that meander like the slithering body of a Kindlewastes Diamondback snake. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Wildheart Seekers
description: A naturalistic dagger set with winding wooden handles. The blades are slightly curved and are ideal for skinning animals. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Wolf Daggers
description: This dagger pair is adorned with a wolf head detail, representing its ferocious strike. Riposte Kick: Allows you to perform a Kick attack shortly after parrying an enemy. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

name: Batwing Axe
description: The blades of this axe have sharp edges that flow into an upper peak. They were crafted like that to break through frozen lake surfaces or walls and resemble bat wings.

name: Bonebreaker
description: A primitive, but well-crafted brutal weapon to splinter the bones of the enemy.

name: Calescent Axe
description: It burns the palms when wielded without caution, leaving blisters and pain even as the heat of battle fades.

name: Celestial Axe
description: An ice-cold axe with a central, vibrant gem. Its blades are adorned with small spikes to cause maximum damage. When this axe rains down on its enemies, it beautifully reflects the sun's light.

name: Dark Cleaver
description: Cleave through it all. Part the Shroud. Excise the tumor.

name: Death Gazer Axe
description: Its crystal eye watches the battlefield, and those it fixes upon rarely see another dawn.

name: Dimweald Axe
description: A one-handed axe, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Lando, the secondborn. He was loyal to the end.

name: Dragonsbane
description:
An axe found atop the skull of a giant dragon skeleton.

Legends say it was used to slay the mother dragon, but it wasn't lodged inside her cranium when you found it. 


That's probably for the best. Mothers have enough headaches already.

name: Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe
description: Those who wield the Drak'Dal Chieftain Axe command great awe — one swing is enough to bring a tribe to its knees. It's taken many lives, and lusts for countless more.

name: Enshrouded Axe
description: A mighty axe which lusts for blood.

name: Fenrig's Axe
description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

name: Final Gambit
description: A decisive strike, freshly spilled blood, and a silence that follows — such are the impressions of a fleeting rush. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Frostwing Axe
description:
Legends say that this weapon was once wielded by a hero who was mangled in battle. He sought a freezing cave to rest and tend to his wounds, leaving a trail of blood in the snow.
Once he emerged after a hundred-year slumber, a swarm of ice bats soared into the night sky, signaling his return.

name: Graven Idol Axe
description: Carved with a stone visage, this axe is as much relic as weapon.

name: Hair Splitter
description: This axe is eerily precise. The hair on your arms stands up as you wield it.

name: Hatchet
description: A versatile one-handed axe. Frequently used to split the skulls of enemies.

name: Jagged Obsidian Axe
description: A savage weapon of black glass. The blade seems almost alive, dark as the void and sharp as Drak scales.

name: Jezmina's Apotheosis
description: An axe that carves a path through enemies, no matter what. Swinging it fearlessly makes it feel light as a feather.

name: Lightforged Axe
description: An axe forged in pure light. Few have witnessed its glory, and those who did were blinded in a flash.

name: Lucent Axe
description: The light it bears is a small comfort amidst the sea of sorrow. A lonely star, a guiding light moving frantically against the black skies.

name: Lumenshade Axe
description: An axe to end any battle — quickly.

name: Lupa's Scalper
description: "Shadow Over Umber Hollow — Lupa" is etched on the side.

name: Molten Axe
description: It feels as though this metal, still carrying a small flame as its eye, like a candle's light, never truly solidified. The axe's body still bends and morphs under your touch, eager to be molded by your grip.

name: Nocturnal Axe
description: Forged from a dark metal, mysterious and silent as the night. This axe does not reflect, does not allow light. Still, you believe you catch reflections dancing across the blade from the corner of your eye... surely, your sight betrays you.

name: Provisional Scythe
description: A provisional tool used to deal fast and ugly cuts.

name: Scavenger Miner Axe
description: It's unclear if this Scavenger Miner Axe was ever meant to pry ore from stone, or to pierce traitors’ backs.

name: Skull Splitter Axe
description: The Skull Splitter gets its name from its merciless nature — cleaving skulls with every swing.

name: Steel Moon Axe
description: An axe with two perfectly rounded, balanced steel blades. They nearly form the shape of the full moon.

name: Sun Axe
description: An axe that shines brightest at dawn, clinging on to hope no matter what.

name: Tainted Axe
description: A mighty one-handed axe, tainted by the blood of the fallen.

name: Thunderbolt Axe
description: This one-handed axe crackles with electrifying energy since it was charged by lightning during a rare desert storm.

name: Veilrift Axe
description: Every swing of this axe leaves a tear in the veil that separates the living from the beyond. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Wolf Pack Axe
description: This Axe is destined to smite down creatures of the wild.

name: Wolf's Claw
description: Strikes with force and leaves devastating wounds. A weapon truly fitting its name.

name: Bonescourge Mace
description: This mace is the bane and banisher of all undead creatures. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Bright Morningstar
description: A club with long, protruding spikes forged from moon-bathed steel. Spilled blood is easily visible on this weapon.

name: Club
description: A club carved out of wood. Not much, but better than nothing.

name: Crown Crusher
description: The four-way cage around the mace's core forms an outward radiating crown when raised above the wielder's head. This serves as a final fanfare to victims before they're crushed at their ruler's feet. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Dark Morningstar
description: Children rumored that people killed by this Morningstar would have their souls banished inside the orb. These remnants would echo aimlessly forever in their spherical prison, bouncing between the curved walls and the void.

name: Dimweald Hammer
description: A mighty hammer, family heirloom of the Dimwealds. This weapon belonged to Berhtolf, the firstborn son. Bravery was his downfall.

name: Enhanced Spiked Club
description: The most basic weaponry, enhanced to be more effective and durable.

name: Fearsome Club
description: This club strikes fear into the hearts of your foes with every swing.

name: Feathered Mace
description: Designed after the fletching of an arrow, this weapon shows true brutality when smiting friend or foe.

name: Fleshgrinder
description: The needles of this spiked club can tenderize countless meat bags to mush.

name: Freshblood Mace
description: When a drakling hatches from its shell, its lowered, elongated body appears almost snake-like. However, they soon adapt an upright posture and bare their teeth — this process is represented through the design of this mace.

name: Gorestriker
description: A deadly club that will decimate any enemy.

name: Iron Claw Club
description: A mace that easily cleaves through foes like a pack of starving wolves.

name: Mace of Denial
description: It was customary in the far North to carry the dead to their graves while brandishing a steel mace. This presentation of stalwart strength in the face of death and terror would ward off evil spirits and guide the dead safely to the Northwinds of the afterlife.

name: Mace of Wrath
description: In the bygone days, young men would carry maces like these to thrash and toil amongst one another like a dark, thundering storm. It helped to release anger and weed out the weak.

name: Mace-like Club
description: Don't let the image deceive you. It might look like a mace, but it's a primitive club after all.

name: Meat Chopper
description: A primitively crafted but brutal weapon, awaiting its next prey.

name: Metalstar Mace
description: A six-edged mace made from heavy metal. The head of this weapon resembles a star.

name: Spiked Club
description: A slightly improved version of the Club, reinforced with spikes.

name: Totemhead Mace
description: A ghastly visage is carved into the mace, looking down on your foes as you smash them into the ground.

name: Totempole Mace
description: A mace with a segmented body, reminiscent of a totem pole climbing towards the sky. The head is augmented with a stone crown that radiates outwards.

name: Twin Soul Mace
description: A perfectly balanced mace, where each front mirrors the opposite side.

name: Vesztah's Mace
description: Two mirrored Drak are represented on this mace. Despite being outwardly similar, they may not share the same fate — for the Broodmother's duality demands the weak become a feast for the strong.

name: Wolf's Hydra
description: A heavy club adorned with multiple wolf heads near the handle.

name: Acid Cleaver
description: A cleaver coated with acid and bile, swung by Scavenger Butchers. Its victims can mend the bleeding — but rarely stop the toxins from spreading.

name: Apex Machete
description: The weapon brandishes an interlocking pattern of dark and light by partially covering its fuller with a blackened outer shell. The sword's sides are asymmetric, making one ideal for slashing while the other excels in prying or hacking through its pronounced claw-like appendage.

name: Aurora Sword
description: All incoming light fractures on the surface of this elegant blade, creating a dancing ensemble of floating colors. It is practically dripping with excellence.

name: Bright Hope Sword
description: An iron blade erupts from the golden handle, splitting it like a growing sprig leaping through gilded leaves. Hope always finds a way to grow, even in the darkest of times.

name: Bronze Sword
description: A light and swift sword of beautiful color. It dulls quickly, though.

name: Dragon Sword
description: A mythical blade from long gone days. Legends say that it was passed on to Embervale by a wise spirit who descended from the stars in the year of the dragon.

name: Drak'Dal Spine
description: Ridges line the base of this sword, adding weight to each swing. The uneven silhouette is reminiscent of protruding vertebrae.

name: Eclipsed Blade
description: Rays of steel stretch outward from the sword handle's guard. They resemble the final light of the sun before an eclipse. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Enflamed Sword
description: A burning sword, glowing with power. It burns hot enough to reduce the mana of its prey with every hit.

name: Explorer's Machete
description: A sword with a reinforced, pointed edge that can cut through any growth in the thicket. The blade is also useful for hunting wildlife.

name: Extinguished Sword
description: Although no longer enflamed this formerly magical sword still has a sharp edge.

name: Ezramin's Courage
description: "It's not right to leave humanity behind. Their world is ours. I feel, no, I know that this is my home. Stars be damned — Let's fight for Embervale!" - Ezramin

name: Fang Blade
description: This blade is razor-sharp like the fangs of the terrifying creatures that prowl the Nomad Highlands.

name: Fell Broad Sword
description: A heavy sword wielded by armored Fell soldiers and commanders.

name: Greater Golden Twinflame Sword
description: An elaborate sword, decorated in gold filigree. It came from the skies as a shooting star years ago, and fell into the gaping maw of a cave.

name: Hailscourge
description: A blade that's cold to the touch. It weighs heavily on the mind.

name: Icefang Blade
description: A blade that seems to be forged from ice itself.

name: Icicle Sword
description: A sleek silvery sword, slim and reflective like a pure icicle.

name: Lesser Golden Twinflame Sword
description: A weapon that was rumored to have fallen from the stars. The man who found it could never feel whole, always searching for a missing piece.

name: Major Arcana
description: Archaic power sleeps within this blade. It resonates, whispers and sings to those who dare to listen.

name: Minor Arcana
description: Archaic power vibrates deep within this sword.

name: Noble Sword
description: A dignified blade, used to defend the honor and lives of the weak.

name: Nova
description: This sword, bright and blinding, erupts on the battlefield to unleash the original brilliance of the Flame.

name: Pyreblade
description: The Pyreblade is capable of unleashing devastating fire strikes while reflecting a portion of the foe’s own fury back upon them.

name: Pyreheart Blade
description: The blade near the handle is segmented into three shapes, which form an upside-down heart when viewed as a whole. It carries a vermilion gemstone inside that burns bright as a pyre.

name: Rune Apprentice's Sword
description: The simplicity of this sword is deceiving! A faint, magical power radiates from the pastel blue stone forged into the blade. This craftsmanship was very popular with young spell slingers and battle mages.

name: Rune Master's Sword
description: The inscription carved into this sword cannot be deciphered, since the archaic knowledge of rune matching has been lost to time. Whatever the writing entails, it makes the blade overflow with energy.

name: Rusty Short Sword
description: A forgotten sword from long-gone days. Commonly found among the ashes of Embervale.

name: Rusty Sword
description: A rusted Simple Copper Sword, damaged by time itself. Its best days are far gone.

name: Sacrilegious Steelsword
description: A blade forged from the stolen steel of fallen soldiers. It spreads regret and misery. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Scrappy Sword
description: A blunt sword, designed to open up ways. Especially through lines of enemies.

name: Short Sword
description: A basic short sword designed for fights in narrow areas. Remarkably agile with a sharp tip.

name: Soldier's Broadsword
description: A sharpened broadsword. Swinging it comfortably requires strong arms.

name: Spine Of Dalszul
description: Rectangular flints reach outwards from the blade's core, some as big as your fist. Their peaks and valleys make up the image of a gargantuan spine befitting an apex predator — hence the reference to the drakian god who strove for dominion of the continent.

name: Starborn Sword
description: A sword that was forged on a faraway star. Its light is now dormant, but not entirely lost.

name: Stonewrought Sword
description: A once pristine weapon. Now decayed but still just as deadly.

name: Sunbeam
description: A scorching hot blade infused with the desert heart. It can melt both snow and skin.

name: Sword of Radiance
description: A bright and mighty weapon emanating power.

name: Sword Of The Serpent
description: A glistening green blade, perfectly representing the aesthetics of the year of the serpent.

name: Wailing Blade
description: An expertly crafted blade, balanced and sharp. Cuts through foes like a wail through the night. It bears the mark of a famous blacksmith from Pikemead's Reach.

name: White Wolf Sword
description: This sword slices through the air like a sharp howl at midnight.

name: Wolf's Maw
description: A blade that devours foes easily. It carved its name into countless bodies in battle.

name: Beastmaster Shaman Staff
description: A wooden staff from which bioluminescent mushrooms sprout. In the hands of the Vukah, it holds the power to command beasts. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Blackened Staff
description: Every apprentice knows that the Blackened Staff hides dark secrets. Trying to uncover them leads to migraines, nausea, and paranoia. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Clearwater Staff
description: A ceremonial staff, used in part to melt frozen lakes into clear, drinkable water. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Crystalwater Staff
description: A staff that imbues the wielder with the ability to melt ice caps and frozen streams. The resulting fresh water is considered exceptionally pure and healing. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Dark Staff
description: A magical staff, utilizing the power of darkness to cast stronger magic spells. A mighty tool feared by every sorcerer. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Darya's Staff
description: A staff that harnesses the power of the eclipsed sun. It functions best when only a crescent of light is left. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Deceiving Staff
description: The weapon of choice for the deceitful. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Dragoncore Staff
description: A blood-red gem hovers above the staff, exposed and splintered. The era of dragons has long passed. One day, the Dawn Age, the age of mankind, will end, too. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Elder's Staff
description: A magical staff, brimming with the power of its former owner. Legend has it that the elder's soul is linked to it, sometimes humming at night. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Eldermere's Staff
description: "A staff of my own design. The dome that encapsulates the tip can contain highly concentrated bolts of energy before releasing them into the spell of my choosing. The quilted leather along the hilt adds a refined touch, I believe." - Eldermere, Chief Engineer Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Gleaming Staff
description: A magical staff that gleams with hope, able to unleash powerful magical attacks. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Hopeful Glimmer
description: Unyielding and unbroken, this staff resembles the realm's last bastion of hope. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Lightning Shaman Staff
description: This staff is powered by an orb that attracts lightning during thunderstorms. It stores the captured electricity and can unleash it again at a later point. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Luminary Staff
description: A staff that reigns with superior intellectual prowess, ingenuity, and near-boundless energy. It can only be wielded by the brightest minds of our time — or those who deem themselves such. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Mirage
description: All hope is fickle, a mirage on the horizon. This staff makes its bearer reject all convictions to walk into the abyss. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Ony's Staff
description: A sequence of words is etched along the handle. They feel vaguely familiar to you. I fly so high, I may never come down I dance on the sun, whole body ablaze My cup's always full, I'd drink till I drown In liquid light and limerence, until I feel dazed Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Oracle's Everblue
description: "Gaze into the orb," the Oracle said, eyes fixated on her staff. "It shows the past, the present, and the future — and they're all veiled in blue rot". Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Root Staff
description: This staff was made from the roots of an age-old tree. Wisdom and calm flow through it. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Shepherd's Lightning
description: A mighty relic, able to provide solace amidst chaos. The previous owner might have been a retired hero. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Shepherd's Staff
description: A potent staff capable of guiding those who would otherwise be without protection. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Shroud Weaver
description: A malicious staff that effortlessly intertwines the strings of fate with the Shroud. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Sinister Crescent Staff
description: A ritualistic staff that was cleansed in a still rivulet under a crescent moon. It serves the wielder to guide the undead back to the beyond. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Spiritual Cane
description: A basic magical staff that is powered by the wielder's spirituality. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff
description: A simple magical staff made from calcified bone. Rudimentary, but effective. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff of Guidance
description: Use this staff to burn a path for your herd through the frozen wastes and help them conquer the iciest rivulets and rockiest cliffs. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff Of Reeds
description: The mandibles of the staff open towards the skies like a snapjaw's maw, looking to drag prey down to the depths of the moor... Powerful magic cast through this weapon can damn anyone to darkness. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff Of The Moor
description: A sublime staff that carries an eerie visage and blank stare. Its face seems as if it were looking up at you from beneath the motionless surface of a black moor. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff of the Ram
description: A horned staff that has been embellished with alabaster fur. It is soft to the touch. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff Of The Serpent
description: A majestic staff topped with an ouroboros ornament made from green jade. It's perfect for honoring the year of the snake. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Staff of the Taurus
description: A staff that awakes slumbering anger inside the wielder. The protruding amethyst spikes help to channel the emotion towards enemies. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Stormbound Staff
description: The staff's material is engraved with countless labyrinthine lines reminiscent of the chaotic flow of battle. However, a metal halo encircles the negative space within, preserving a sense of calm, as if one were inside the eye of a storm. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Torchlight Staff
description: A staff that was used by magical torchbearers of bygone days. They'd illuminate uncharted caves to claim even the furthest corners of the Albaneve Summits as parts of the northern empire. The scouting went well until the Cyclopes learned that the torchbearers were feeble mages whose light could be snuffed out easily with a decisive boulder toss. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Undergrowth Staff
description: A staff that absorbs energy from the soil. It's brimming with potential. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Vaporous Staff
description: A wild and withered staff, able to unleash the power of the earth. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Violet Storm
description: Spikes disrupt the smooth surface and jut forward like razor blades. They spring from within a center of calm, from the storm's eye, as devastating violet rain on a thunderous night — after which all weakness will be cleansed, and only the strongest may rise from the submerged lands. According to folklore, this symbolizes the origin of the drakian Broodmother Vesztah. Spellcasting: Equip a Staff and Spell Charges, then use Mana to cast.

name: Black Powder Ball
description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Explosive Crawler
description:
A mindless, throwable drone made from critter carapaces. Once deployed, the crawler will seek the nearest enemy and combust.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Explosive Powder Ball
description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Explosive Powder Ball Net
description:
An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Fell Confusion Pheromones
description: Can be thrown to create a Pheromone Cloud that confuses Fell enemies, who run around in panic when affected.

name: Incendiary Ball
description:
This bomb contains a highly flammable liquid, setting a large area on fire when deployed.

The damage caused by this Throwable scales with your Dexterity attribute.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel I
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel II
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel III
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel IV
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Skull Summoning Vessel V
description: Throw this mystical vessel to temporarily summon a skull companion.

name: Abyssal Wing Axe
description: The crystal heart, placed between the wings, pulsates with the cold hunger of the abyss.

name: Blood Omen Axe
description: This colossal axe draws strength from those it wounds, stealing their vitality with each strike.

name: Boreal Axe
description: An axe forged from shadowy steel crowned with a single, slim gemstone. The grip is mantled with boreal wood.

name: Champion's Axe
description: A hefty two-handed axe, usually wielded by champions of the ring! Axes like these are often a status symbol and represent triumph.

name: Curse Bringer Axe
description: Its maw is cradling a gem that glows as the curse is spoken, leaving foes weaker as it feeds itself.

name: Darkwood Axe
description: This is an elevated version of the Boreal Axe. Its head boasts an intricate design, typical for northern craftsmanship.

name: Deeproot Axe
description: Carved from foraged dead wood and dusty roots, this axe was hardened in the sun to tear flesh and split bones.

name: Executioner's Axe
description: An axe of gruesome origin. It has seen many heads roll and still fulfills its purpose today.

name: Golden Recruit Axe
description: The most successful, newly decorated recruits are sometimes gifted weapons dipped in gold. They aren't any sharper than their less impressive counterparts, but serve as a status symbol among the group.

name: Golden War Hero Axe
description: Many soldiers fall in war. Those who return are heralded and showered in gold and gifts; given weapons befitting a celebrated veteran... but for some, such gifts merely serve as a reminder of their harrowing past.

name: Greater Thunderblast Axe
description: An electrically charged two-handed axe, able to release sparks into the overcast sky when striking. It was struck by lightning while inside a cataclysmic typhoon and survived, unlike it's previous owner.

name: Guillotine
description: Heads plummet to the ground, eyes shut in terror. Victims prefer darkness rather than to face the Guillotine.

name: Ruffian's Axe
description: A broad and imposing axe. If you want to leave a fearsome impression, this weapon  will do the trick.

name: Spinechill Axe
description: A menacing axe that sends shivering chills down its victim's back with every heavy two-handed swing. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Ancestral Star
description: An ancestral weapon from the proud family line of the Galeforths, last held by Virgil Galeforth. He famously said: "If you want this weapon, you'll have to pry it from my cold, dead hands".

name: Club of Defiance
description: This club can take on hordes of enemies, never wavering.

name: Flail Of Misery
description: A stout flail that swings from dusk till dawn.

name: Great Mace
description: Easy to use and quite deadly. The sharp blades on the side allow for easier penetration of armor.

name: Masterful Mace
description: This mace is unstoppable once in motion.

name: Misfortune Mace
description: A frightening mace that brings misfortune to any that oppose it.

name: Spine Splinter
description: No armor piece forged today can endure the sheer brutality of this mace.

name: Sun Hammer
description: The sun won't drown in the darkness of night. It will rise again.

name: Barbarian Greatsword
description: Miscreants, brutes, and evil doers of the past would often wield similar blades. Perhaps this weapon was forged in the shadows of a back alley and changed hands on the black market.

name: Chimerical Greatsword
description: A weapon born from the amalgamation of bones, earth, and liquid fire. As your eyes travel across it, the mess of cartilage and moss at the hilt gives way to a light-swallowing obsidian blade.

name: Fell Black Knight Greatsword
description: The weapon of choice for Lord Vorgoth's personal guard. Blue lines follow the blade's body, carving around its peaks and valleys like the north winds.

name: Fell Striker Greatsword
description: A blade commonly used by the Striker commando of the Fell. It's brutal, jagged, and efficient.

name: Goldlaced Greatsword
description: An azure gem, curved guard, and gold-patterened edge embellish this sword. All in all, it is both beautiful and deadly.

name: Greatsword Of Embers
description: A luminous greatsword that reaches towards the sun above like a rekindled fire. It slashes through the night with vigor, creating light in the dark.

name: Greatsword Of The Motherflame
description: An honorable greatsword that resembles the Motherflame herself. Wield it with passion — and caution. Carrying this sword binds one to duty!

name: Greatsword Of The Old Order
description: Before the fall, many guards and knights of Embervale would brandish swords such as these. Perhaps their spirit lives on through your righteous strikes.

name: Guard Of The North Sword
description: Lord Vorgoth's once-trusted blade was discarded before the war and replaced by a weapon more befitting vile acts. It still clings to a semblance of sanity and light, shining brightly in the dark like the North Star.

name: Horned Greatsword
description: Sharp extensions jut out from the blade's periphery: an assortment of stingers, sharpened flint, and horns. A strike from this jagged edge will rip and tear almost anything.

name: Ironheart Greatsword
description: An iron core lies hidden inside the blade's casing, peeking out from the silver curtains on the blade's flat.

name: Lorekeeper's Greatsword
description: A large greatsword with a subtle circle pattern. You get the feeling that each curve could resemble a syllable, interlocking where they rhyme to create poetry... however, you could not possibly ascertain meaning from the symbols.

name: Manathor's Greatsword
description: "Embervale is nothing but a speck of dust; a single point in time from which we will propel ourselves forward. We'll leap from here, into the future — towards the stars above. Towards home. No matter where we land... we will make our mark. They will remember us. They will remember me." - Manathor

name: Megalodon Greatsword
description: You see it before your inner eyes: A giant, submerged in the deep ocean blue, controlling the tides with each laboring, drawn-out exhale. The depths are calling. Will you answer?

name: Morningdew Greatsword
description: No matter how dire the night may be, with the rising sun comes sweet morning dew.

name: New Moon Greatsword
description: A hollow shape, empty as the night sky on a new moon, adorns this weapon's hand guard. The blade has been dirtied, but refuses to shed its silvery sheen.

name: Ornate Greatsword
description: The embellishments on this sword seem inspired by eastern craftsmanship, but the choice of material betrays the maker's origin. This weapon was most likely forged by a well-traveled blacksmith or commissioned by an aristocrat.

name: Princely Greatsword
description: A noble sabre that impresses with its golden glow and broad blade. Perhaps the former owner was compensating for something.

name: Protector Greatsword
description: Girdles and cloth wrap tightly around the hilt, proposing the story of an unlikely protector having to adjust the grip on the weapon spontaneously.

name: Rusty Greatsword
description: An old greatsword that's begun to decay. The steel's purity has been stripped away by rust.

name: Scrappy Greatsword
description: A broken blade, retrieved from the rubble and ash of the old world. It may still cause significant damage when in the wrong hands.

name: Sharktooth Greatsword
description: The edges of this blade are indented and therefore resemble cuts made by razor-sharp fins or rows of shark teeth.

name: Shroud Vessel's Greatsword
description: A tainted blade. Fading memories still reverberate from it, but the man who was once haunted by them is long gone. You freed Embervale — and him, too.

name: Sickle Greatsword
description: Once upon a time, Orpheus, a dark dragon, descended from the mountains to wreak havoc on the people's crops. Determined, the farmers laid down their scythes to join in the righteous crusade against the creature, forcing it to retreat with but one blow. While their names were forgotten, their fabled blades served as inspiration for many blacksmith apprentices.

name: Silvernight Greatsword
description: Here, you can see howling wolves, and the ties that bind them to the moon above — all depicted in allegory through simple design choices.

name: Spiked Greatsword
description: Every rose has thorns — and sometimes, nature can serve as inspiration for weaponry and design!

name: Abysswalker
description: A heavy weapon, fit for descending any abyss — both literally and figuratively. Shroud Imbued: This weapon has been enshrouded and deals heavy Shroud damage. It can only be found inside Shroud Lairs.

name: Aerostriker
description: A heavy hammer that strikes true, like a bird of prey.

name: Battering Ram Hammer
description: A heavy two-handed hammer that can break through any door thanks to the added front spikes. Bashing, tearing, and slashing are no problem for this weapon!

name: Blessed Club
description: A club that was bathed in divine waters, thus acquiring a blessing of protection. Turns out blessings are less effective than cold, hard steel when caught in an ambush.

name: Chieftain's Hammer
description: An elaborate weapon adorned with prized horns, probably trophies from past hunts. At times, the Drak would make sacrifices to their gods in Ark Morgo to channel their elemental affinities. Therefore, this axe of a tribal chief was imbued with the power of lightning to aid in their pursuits.

name: Dreadbane
description: A large and powerful hammer that has been corrupted by the Shroud. Good for smashing bugs!

name: Frost Smasher
description: Every aspect of this hammer's head is designed meticulously. The front and back boast a colorful yet distinguished design, while the sides share a row of spikes. Appealing, and functional.

name: Goat Hammer
description: A hammer that has been further improved by an added goat horn in the back. Only the finest, most sturdy horns are selected!

name: Hammer Of The Piercing Gaze
description: A set of crystal eyes adorns this weapon, seeking the weak points of your foes. The handle has been decorated with overlapping leather straps.

name: Head Pounder
description: A gigantic hammer that can only be wielded with both hands. The head was forged from one solid block of steel, requiring advanced crafting techniques.

name: Ignited Hammer
description: Inheriting the power of the Flame, this hammer can break through lines of enemies easily.

name: Mandible Crusher
description: Striking with staggering force, this hammer obliterates the Hollow by grinding their bones to dust. Hollow Echo: The weapon unleashes an unholy echo that magically extends the attack range.

name: Massive Hammer
description: A large hammer, made from a combination of rock and steel. The mix of materials makes it especially heavy.

name: Rotblood
description: A mighty hammer, corrupted to the core. The power of the Shroud is channeled in this weapon.

name: Soothsayer
description: A hammer adorned with an ancient petrified tusk. Tusks and teeth were used by the Vukah for mystical purposes.

name: Tribal Hammer
description: A common hammer that may have once been used by ancient Drak'Dal tribe members. Its simple design speaks to its utilitarian nature.

name: Wooden Tooth
description: A traditional and excellently carved wooden hammer made by Vukah craftsmen. Resembles a large tooth and is very good at removing such.

name: Ancient Drak Wand
description: A primordial wand that speaks of the previous dominion of the Drak. When the Drak'Dal were pushed back to the archipelago after they attacked humanity, their craft degenerated significantly, thus losing the ability to reproduce designs such as this. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Androme's Wand
description: "My dear students, I depart once more... but do not fret! I've prepared a task — and a wand to help you solve it — for my absence! Use this tool to trace the constellations in the sky. Can you find the sign of the Pheonix?" - Professor Androme Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Apprentice Wand
description: Modified to increase the mana control, this wand shoots ice projectiles with a bit more force. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Ashwood Wand
description: A wand that burns with the same destructive force that has razed villages, libraries, and museums. Artefacts and tomes, burnt to a crisp and falling to dust... can you wield this power responsibly? Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Blazing Wand
description: A wand that deals significant fire damage, eradicating anything in its path. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Blizzard Wand
description: The frozen root wrapped around the icy core of this wand spirals like the howling winds of a blizzard. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Candlelight Wand
description: It burns softly, just enough to brighten the dark hallways of forgotten archives. Riddles with lost answers, poems with rhymes that flutter and flee, and stories of unwritten ends reveal themselves before you. Keep their memory alive. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Coalescent Wand
description: The wielder's energy melts inside the wand's empty husk and reforms to shoot forth a boundless stream of elemental energy. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Cracklewood Wand
description: A wand that crackles with energy as it nurtures spark and flame. While wielding it, you feel as though it may burst into flame at any moment. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Crackling Wand
description: Fire proves to be an excellent weapon against creatures of the Shroud. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Cryptic Wand
description: A strange wand that was covered by ashes. Its body bends and twists, but never breaks. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Darya's Remorse
description: A wand that burns as bright as the sun. It's decorated with a flower that wraps around the handle, blooming near the hilt. Despite its radiance, it carries a dark energy — is it remorse, or the curse of the Shroud? Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Darya's Wand
description: A wand that harnesses the power of the eclipse. It functions best when the sun is fully submerged in darkness, and only a faint rim of light shines through. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Electric Initialiser
description: An electrifying wand that was previously used to start engines and machinery in an instant. The air crackles around it, and it has an odd shape. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Elm's Eye Wand
description: Wildly grown sprigs that coil around a negative space — the eye of the elm, observing its own demise. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Frost Wand
description: A wand that focuses the wielder's power through a frozen crystal. Magical energy is refracted inside and amplified with every reflection. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Frozen Core Wand
description: This wand hides a rare frozen core inside, enabling its owner to unleash massive ice damage against foes. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Helix
description: A perplexing wand, corrupted by the Shroud. It bends the mind of its bearer. Ethereal Duplication: The wand's unique magic grants it a 30% chance to spontaneously create an additional projectile. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Infernal Wand
description: Marked through hundreds of hours of enduring the force of fire, this wand has a connection to the element and is able to utilize it. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Luminous Wand
description: This wand grants power over fire to whoever is brave enough to wield it. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Mythic Wand
description: Many amethyst stones were used to forge this wand. They are needed to prevent combustion when this weapon inevitably overheats from the bundled energy inside! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Polymath's Wand
description: A wand that especially talented scholars of the arcane forces favor. It's versatile and reflects the wielder's brilliance. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Proto Matter-Bender
description: A traditional Ancient tool used to adjust the subject's physical matter or shell after arrival. It can also be used to unleash the full wonder of blunt force trauma. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Reaper's Wand
description: A twisted wand emitting a faint, blue light. It demands to be wielded! Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage. Multishot: Fires multiple projectiles but at reduced damage.

name: Recent Drak Wand
description: A simplified wand, shaped by the resurgence of the Drak. Weapons such as these would've held great power in the past, but the primal knowledge surrounding their creation was lost. Recently crafted wands are therefore more primitive, and mere imitations of the once undeniable power and dominion of the beasts. Overcharge: This wand holds a chance to amplify its damage output. Attacks deal bonus damage up to the overcharge percentage.

name: Ritual Tempest Wand
description: This ceremonial wand was often used when praying for downpours when the drought first started. While that didn't work, you can still use it to call lightning down on your enemies!
